0.label: Seated portraits / marked prints
0.basis: Center and random examples show seated or half-length portraits, often with visible crop marks; 728 of 749 catalog media are prints.

1.label: Dark-toned portrait prints
1.basis: Reviewed examples show portraits with dark clothing, backgrounds, or print tones; 619 of 764 catalog media are prints. Tonal description is provisional.

2.label: Mounted images / graphic material
2.basis: Center examples include mounted reproductions titled Drawing, Landscape and Entities; random and edge examples include other subjects. This is a mixed group.

3.label: Film edges / perforations
3.basis: Reviewed center and random examples prominently show film perforations across different depicted subjects; not a claim about every image.

4.label: Seated portraits / negatives
4.basis: Center examples show seated portrait compositions including catalog-titled Holkar Bahadur images; 902 of 922 catalog media are negatives.

5.label: Half-length portraits / prints
5.basis: Reviewed examples show seated, bust and half-length portraits; 909 of 976 catalog media are prints. Overlaps thematically with other portrait groups.

6.label: Front-facing portraits / negatives
6.basis: Center examples emphasize front-facing and seated portrait compositions; 1166 of 1226 catalog media are negatives. Profiles and other compositions also occur.

7.label: Objects / masks / graphic forms
7.basis: Center and random examples include still-life objects, a mask, rayograph-like forms and portraits; catalog titles corroborate the mixed object-related theme.

8.label: Interiors / people in settings
8.basis: Reviewed center examples include interiors, studio objects and people in surrounding space; catalog titles mention apartments, an atelier and street settings.

9.label: Groups / horizontal scenes
9.basis: Center examples show groups, children and a chess gathering, often in horizontal frames; random and edge examples are more heterogeneous.

10.label: Reproductions / framed forms
10.basis: Center examples and frequent catalog titles include reproductions of artwork and rayographs, alongside portraits and objects; 628 of 739 media are negatives.

11.label: Architecture / landscapes / travel
11.basis: Reviewed center and random examples show streets, buildings, ports and landscapes; frequent catalog titles corroborate outdoor and travel subjects.

12.label: Portraits / poses / negatives
12.basis: Center examples show portraits, expressive poses and hands, with heterogeneous edge cases; 1176 of 1211 catalog media are negatives.

13.label: Body studies / expressive poses
13.basis: Reviewed examples include full-body poses, dance-like gestures, body studies and figures; catalog titles include Nu and fashion-related material. No gender inference.

14.label: Full-length / fashion / costume
14.basis: Center and random examples show full-length clothing and costume presentations; fashion and performance-related catalog titles support this tentative theme.

15.label: Bust portraits / gestures / prints
15.basis: Reviewed examples emphasize bust portraits, heads, hands and posed gestures; 648 of 748 catalog media are prints. Not an exclusive subject category.
